limitations: ASSISTments public item identifiers have no separate catalog metadata.
Formal test ranking is deferred to G5-05B.

metricDefinitions.coverage: unique recommended itemExternalId / train candidate count
metricDefinitions.diversity: mean pairwise 1-cosine of atomic skill one-hot vectors; null for list <2
metricDefinitions.ndcgAt5: binary relevance and IDCG length min(5, |relevantItems|)

rules.candidateConstruction: train-only item directory, skill map, popularity and Item-CF
rules.content: atomic skillExternalId one-hot; composite token never split; correct unused
rules.hybrid: per-user candidate-set min-max; constant component zero; positive-weight fallback counted
rules.itemCf: binary train CSR, cosine column similarity, diagonal excluded
rules.ranking: final score descending, raw POPULAR descending, itemExternalId ascending
rules.relevance: future itemExternalId deduplicated excluding unknownItem and previouslySeenItem
rules.selection: NDCG, Recall, HitRate, Precision descending then weight tuple lexicographic ascending
rules.split: 按顺序切分; sequenceIndex/order_id is not real-time

validation.selectionRule: NDCG, Recall, HitRate, Precision descending then weight tuple lexicographic ascending
